name: project-eric
description: Project Eric — Security-First Web IDE with integrated OWASP Top 10 (2026) analysis.

scripts.owasp:install-vscode: powershell -Command "& { $vsix = Get-ChildItem artifacts/*.vsix -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if ($vsix) { Start-Process 'code' -ArgumentList '--install-extension', $vsix.FullName } else { Write-Error 'Run npm run owasp:package first' } }"
scripts.owasp:cs-install: powershell -Command "& { $vsix = Get-ChildItem artifacts/*.vsix -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if ($vsix) { $cs = 'C:\tools\code-server\bin\code-server.exe'; if (Test-Path $cs) { & $cs --install-extension $vsix.FullName } else { Write-Error 'code-server not installed. Run npm run ide:setup first.' } } else { Write-Error 'Run npm run owasp:package first.' } }"
